'''Krisa''' is from [[Seanchan]].

== Activities ==
Krisa is part of the [[Corenne]]. She has hired three assassins from Seanchan to attack [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]].

==Trivia==
*Krisa is named after Kris Ring, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
